CURITIBA, BRAZIL · EST. 2026

Helping builders see what their AI is doing.
OUR STORY

Foglamp was founded in 2026 in Curitiba, Brazil, to make AI agents easier to understand, debug, and operate.

As agents grew from a single model call into workflows of models, tools, and handoffs, the usual application logs stopped telling the whole story. Foglamp was built to close that gap: one place to see traces, latency, token usage, costs, and evaluations across the full run.

Today, Foglamp is an open-source, self-hostable observability platform for teams building with the Vercel AI SDK. The goal is simple: give developers the clarity to ship capable agents with confidence.

The team
TWO FOUNDERS
Gustavo Fior

Co-founder & builder

Gustavo leads product and engineering at Foglamp, building the tools he wants when shipping AI products himself.

LinkedIn
Abdul Haidar

Co-founder

Abdul is a co-founder of Foglamp, working alongside Gustavo to build clearer infrastructure for AI products.
